name: Little Something
layout_recipe: Offset folded note with seal and a short salutation
cover_copy: I have a little something for you.
designer_notes: A tiny original folded-corner motif; warm display title; no photo required.

name: Birthday Confetti
layout_recipe: Large headline above an inset scratch patch; scattered cut-paper edges
cover_copy: Your birthday surprise is hiding here.
example_final_headline: We are going for a brilliant day out.
designer_notes: A few intentionally placed paper shapes; no endless falling confetti.

name: The Big Number
layout_recipe: Oversized optional milestone number with inset message panel
cover_copy: A big day deserves a little suspense.
designer_notes: Age is optional display text; no birth date; balance number and readable title.

name: Hidden Present
layout_recipe: Three stacked clue cards and a final location note
cover_copy: Your surprise is closer than you think.
designer_notes: Handwritten-style numbering via type, not a detective-game dashboard.

name: Ticket Night
layout_recipe: Wide ticket silhouette with type-led event strip and perforated edge
example_final_headline: We have tickets for the show.
designer_notes: A reveal announcement, not a valid admission ticket; no barcode imitation.

name: Weekend Away
layout_recipe: Postcard-like destination blocks, then a broad final note
example_final_headline: We are getting away for the weekend.
designer_notes: Abstract landscape shapes, not copyrighted destination photography.

name: Dinner Is On Me
layout_recipe: Tall menu-like typography with a small place-setting line motif
example_final_headline: Dinner is on me this Friday.
designer_notes: Restaurant-like restraint without impersonating a real restaurant or voucher.

name: Good News
layout_recipe: Strong centred headline behind two flat-colour graphic panels
designer_notes: Distinct poster composition; suitable for messages that are not purchased gifts.

name: A Proper Thank You
layout_recipe: Broad serif thank-you with a small signed note beneath
cover_copy: A little thank you, properly wrapped.
example_final_headline: A treat to say how much your help meant.
designer_notes: Comfortable for friends, neighbours and professional contacts.

name: Team Thank You
layout_recipe: Aligned logo area, calm heading, signature and message
cover_copy: A thank you from all of us.
example_final_headline: A small treat for a brilliant contribution.
designer_notes: Logo optional; readable text rather than trophy clip art; no fake endorsement.

name: Client Appreciation
layout_recipe: Editorial note with left-aligned heading and a narrow colour rule
example_final_headline: A small gift with our appreciation.
designer_notes: Opt-in authorised logo; no client-list import, redemption flow or business dashboard.

name: Winter Surprise
layout_recipe: Graphic paper parcel with a calm winter border
cover_copy: A little surprise for the season.
example_final_headline: Something lovely is waiting for you.
designer_notes: Broad seasonal wording; no presumed religion or mandatory holiday date.
